system.description: The person has learned management and administration in various forms. It can be anything from controlling a village or town to planning wars and campaigns. The handler is the one behind a city’s prosperity and knows why taxes are needed, who runs the administration, and what they do. Even if the handler does not know everyone personally , they know which authorities are responsible for which tasks.
system.summary: Covers management and administration from village to town, up to planning wars and campaigns.
